U.note: Pretty ring card with mode tabs and settings, accurate end-time countdown and auto mode switch, but no screen-reader support and no skip or end feedback beyond a beep.

V.note: Huge full-bleed clock, colour per phase, strong a11y (timer, live status, shortcuts) and robust logic, though auto-start, chime toggle, notifications and persistence stretch past simple.

W.note: Logic and a11y are good, but an inline font-size:inherit on the h1 shrinks the clock to tiny text, wrecking hierarchy so the time is not clear at a glance.

X.note: Big readable clock with phase colour, accurate timing, skip/reset, keyboard and aria-label, and a clean minimal scope; mobile layout a bit loose.

Y.note: Polished dark card with ring and editable durations, correct timing, but no aria support or live announcements and the skip-from-focus counts as a finished pomodoro.

Z.note: Large clock, clear phase and status text, correct drift-free countdown and transitions with live-region announcements, the primary button emphasised, and a tight, focused feature set.
